SELECT f.id, f.rate_code, f.name, f.cycle_type, f.day_count, f.day_interval, f.day_times, f.week_cycle_flag, f.total_execution_count, f.execution_period, f.execution_period_unit, f.applicable_scenes, f.allow_cross_day, f.active_flag, f.sort_no FROM cus_frequency f
f.is_deleted = 0 AND f.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND (f.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR f.rate_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY f.sort_no ASC, f.id DESC

SELECT f.id, f.rate_code, f.name, f.cycle_type, f.day_count, f.day_interval, f.day_times, f.week_cycle_flag, f.total_execution_count, f.execution_period, f.execution_period_unit, f.applicable_scenes, f.allow_cross_day, f.active_flag, f.sort_no FROM cus_frequency f WHERE f.is_deleted = 0 AND f.id = #{id} AND f.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT CAST(f.sort_no AS CHAR) AS sort, f.rate_code AS value, f.name AS label FROM cus_frequency f WHERE f.is_deleted = 0 AND f.active_flag = 1 AND f.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY f.sort_no ASC, f.id DESC
